evidence.notes: Seeded partial-day Holiday windows subtract only the closed local minutes from BusinessHours.diff.
Seeded Holiday recurrence metadata supports daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, linked, and global local closures.
Linked holidays close only the seeded BusinessHours calendar they are associated with.
